findings.description: At 00:00.000 the unobstructed bowl contains 8 balls: 2 red, 3 yellow and 3 green. The child reaches into the bowl and lifts a red ball at 00:00.750, yet the same 8-ball arrangement remains below. Clear frames from 00:01.000 through 00:02.000 show 2 red balls still in the bowl plus the held red ball, increasing the combined total to 9.
